caseName: Fred F. French Investing Co. v. City of New York
caseNameFull: Fred F. French Investing Co., Inc. v. City of New York and Ramsgate Properties, Inc. v. City of New York

opinions.text: Appeals from Ct. App. N. Y. dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeals were taken as petitions for certiorari, certiorari denied.
